claims.claim: Thirty-three rounds of selection produced an RNA polymerase ribozyme that copies functional RNAs with 94 percent fidelity per nucleotide, up from 86 percent.
claims.episode_span: Thirty-three rounds of selection produced an RNA polymerase ribozyme that copies functional RNAs with 94 percent fidelity per nucleotide. The improvement came from fewer mismatched incorporations and fewer extensions of partial products that ended in mismatches.
claims.source_title: Enhanced Fidelity and Sequence Generality of an RNA Polymerase Ribozyme
claims.supporting_quote: By applying stringent selection pressure over the course of 33 successive rounds of evolution, both the fidelity and sequence generality of the polymerase were greatly improved. When synthesizing large functional RNAs such as the class I ligase ribozyme, the fidelity improved from 86% to 94% per nucleotide

claims.claim: A review of nearly 400 studies shows birds transport nutrients from land, lakes and sea through waste and carcasses.
claims.episode_span: A review of nearly 400 studies shows birds transport nutrients from land, lakes and sea through waste and carcasses. The movement alters soil chemistry, water chemistry, plant growth and animal communities far from the birds' nesting sites.
claims.source_title: Birds are among Earth's most important nutrient movers
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers from Cornell and five other institutions reviewed nearly 400 scientific papers to show how birds transport nutrients from land, lake and sea through their waste and bodies.
